status: unqualified source/component checkpoint; production startup and packaging disabled
implemented: One bounded predicted UID BODY read after complete scoped inventory for the ordinary contiguous fast-message path, without a separate UID enumeration.
Empty/refused prediction, sequence movement, missing/later UID visibility and delivery pressure request inventory instead of silently advancing a UID cursor.
Actual sequence numbers and EXPUNGE/count invalidation are discovery hints only; stored proof remains pinned to actual UID/account/folder/UIDVALIDITY.
Inventory and direct read use the same scoped physical authentication, durable accounting, replay admission, delivery and quota limits.
Cold TLS/HTTP over accounted IMAP now uses direct read turns on fast and complete inventory on bulk.
measurement_boundary: The command-count test observes one initial metadata query and one BODY query for the next contiguous message, with no intervening metadata query. This is not an application latency, raw-Rambler or sustained-bandwidth result.
implementation_choice: The prototype considered numeric sequence FETCH, but production Poll uses exact UID FETCH: nonexistent UIDs are legal empty queries, whereas issuing a nonexistent sequence number can be refused as a bad message set. UID misses explicitly force inventory; no speculative range exceeds one BODY.
limits: One account, one in-process pump and pre-established Noise/grants; no calibrated independent provider/client/server timing.
Adaptive carrier coordinator, receiver-window integration, roster/control bootstrap, reclamation/recovery and Android TUN qualification remain incomplete.
No sustained 100Mbps or <=250ms idle / <=2000ms loaded RTT proof; no deployable package.
